items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I was in 19, say 1920, at Fortify. And, uh, Manetto was on the piano and I was playing guitar. John Veen on the drum. And, uh, Tinette on the violin.

ctx.x: What about somebody like Tinette? Do you remember Tinette?
Tinette, Tinette was a good musician. He was a violin player.
